title: Inventory: Treusch et al. 2015 (PLOS Genetics 11:e1004913) supporting information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/treusch2015/raw/`: the 14 supporting-information files of
PLOS serves them without file names; each is saved as `journal.pgen.1004913.sNNN` with the extension of its detected type.
The article page itself is kept as `sources/treusch2015/article.html` (captions, methods and the numbers the tests check).

roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s001.tif: S1 Fig. Phenotyping of 17-20 individual segregants per round-robin cross and the parents in 1 M NaCl and 20 mM caffeine (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s002.tif: S2 Fig. Conversion of allele frequencies to LOD scores with MULTIPOOL; 2-LOD intervals shown (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s003.tif: S3 Fig. Allele frequencies and LOD plots of replicate BY/RM selections (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s004.tif: S4 Fig. Per-cross LOD plots of the MATa and MATα selections for salt and caffeine, with 2-LOD intervals (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s005.xlsx: S1 Table. Phenotypes of 65 strains (growth adjusted for YPD) in 15 mM caffeine and 1 M NaCl, two biological replicates; round-robin parents in bold.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s006.xlsx: S2 Table. The 12 round-robin crosses (MATx and MATa parent), segregant phenotype distributions, epistasis tests and QTL patterns.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s007.xlsx: S3 Table. Replicate-confirmed BY/RM QTL (LOD > 5, found in at least one pair of technical replicates). Ingested.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s008.xlsx: S4 Table. Grouped round-robin QTL: combined LOD, max-LOD position, 2-LOD interval, crosses with the QTL, coding-variant association scores, candidate genes. Core input.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s009.xlsx: S5 Table. SGD GO analyses of genes with non-synonymous coding variants in salt and caffeine QTL intervals.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s010.xlsx: S6 Table. ENA2 and ENA6 copy numbers in the 12 round-robin parents.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s011.xlsx: S7 Table. Strains contributing beneficial and deleterious alleles to each grouped QTL; side table with each parent's subgroup and source. Ingested.
roles.journal.pgen.1004913.s012.xlsx: S8 Table. MAT-dependent QTL (MATa vs MATα pools) per cross and condition, with candidate genes; bold rows = found in multiple conditions. Ingested.

missing: No genome-wide LOD or allele-frequency traces: the paper deposits VCFs, mapping data and R scripts on Dryad (doi:10.5061/dryad.j20f0), which is not reachable from the build environment.
No per-cross LOD or interval for grouped QTL: S4 gives one combined LOD, max-LOD position and interval per group, and the list of crosses.
No effect sizes: X-QTL report allele-frequency LOD; direction is given only as strains with beneficial or deleterious alleles (S7).
No segregant counts per pool (500,000 sorted cells per mating type; Methods).
